text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives present from Baath party cadre.
- Saddam chairs meeting of Iraqi leaders to discuss a number of political issues and review results of visits by Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz to both Russia and China.
- Saddam says the day to liberate Jerusalem is coming to please both Arabs and Moslems.
- National Assembly speaker takes part in Arab parliamentary meeting in Cairo.
- More calls from Arab and friendly countries urging removal of sanctions on Iraq.
- Kuwaiti authorities release five Iraqi fishermen.
(The above were also carried by AL-THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Article on concept of incentives in the thinking of the ruling Baath party.
- Article on the financial and technological benefits to be gained from Iraq's oil deal with Russia.
- University chancellors and deans expose violations by U.N. arms inspectors of university campuses.
- Editorial attacks American claims that Iraq still poses a threat to its neighbours.
- Commentary urges Turkey to give its anti-Iraq policies following the signing of a gas deal with Baghdad.
- Efforts underway to bring this year's harvest to success.
- Editorial attempts to explain what course of action the new British government will take vis-a-vis Iraq.
